correctness.rationale: The complete P^1 evaluation kernel is O(-1)^a, so factoring the tensor product evaluation in two orders produces the actual global sequences 0→O(-1,0)^{a(b+1)}→E→O(a,-1)^b→0 and 0→O(0,-1)^{b(a+1)}→E→O(-1,b)^a→0. On the two rays the factors have equal slopes and are semistable, hence the extensions semistable and not stable. Torres-López–Zamora Corollary 3.5 really covers Hirzebruch F_0 and says E is L-stable: its hypothesis -K·L=2(a+b)>=4 holds. Each proper subsheaf slope difference is linear in (alpha,beta), nonpositive at both bounding rays and negative at L, so it is strictly negative in the whole interior. In exterior chambers, exact decreasing-slope semistable factor extensions are the HN filtrations. Rank/c2 follow from the complete evaluation Chern character; solving strict inequalities for d yields the stated floor formula. Independent exact rational comparisons passed 63,504 parameter/polarization cases, not relied on for global stability.
